description: Post-flight cost + outcome log for commercial GPU rental train run. MANDATORY emit within 24h of rental termination per CHARTER-RIDER §2(i)(2)(3). Pairs with a preceding com.etzhayyim.train.rentalAttestation record. Records actual wall, actual cost, output checkpoint CID, IPFS pin verify CID, eval metrics, and commit decision.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of cost log emit (post-flight).

rentalAttestationUri.description: AT URI of preceding com.etzhayyim.train.rentalAttestation record, e.g., at://did:web:mac-260317.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.train.rentalAttestation/3kt6f5...

actualWallMinutes.description: Actual wall time IN MINUTES (integer). Delta from expectedWallMinutes >50% triggers post-mortem note in this record.

actualUsdCostMillicents.description: Actual billed cost IN MILLICENTS (= USD × 100000, integer). Delta from expectedUsdCostMillicents >50% triggers post-mortem note.

outputCheckpointCid.description: IPFS CID of merged checkpoint (HF dir or .safetensors). Result of e7m-dataset add of the train output directory.

ipfsPinVerifyCid.description: Verification round-trip CID — output of e7m-dataset verify <subdataset>. Confirms bytes are retrievable from Kubo daemon on mac-260317 (per ADR-2605241500 §'add / publish-ipfs default to dry-run for the PDS step' — manual verify required).

evalMetrics.description: Eval metrics computed on the merged checkpoint via fleet split-role (ADR-2605262100 §5). All scores stored as PERMILLE (parts per thousand, integer 0..1000); divide by 10 for percentage.

langgraphCodingPass1Permille.description: Primary eval — 70-tools/scripts/bench/langgraph-coding 50-prompt exec-graded pass@1, IN PERMILLE (0..1000; divide by 10 for %).

humanevalplusPass1Permille.description: Secondary eval — evalplus/humanevalplus 164-prompt pass@1 IN PERMILLE. Regression sanity (Δ ≥ 0 required).

mbppPlusPass1Permille.description: R2 deferred eval — MBPP+ 974-prompt pass@1 IN PERMILLE.

deltaLanggraphCodingPermille.description: Δ vs pre-train baseline langgraph-coding pass@1 IN PERMILLE (can be negative; +30 = +3pp). Commit gate threshold = +30 per ADR-2605262100 §5.4.

deltaHumanevalplusPermille.description: Δ vs pre-train baseline HumanEval+ pass@1 IN PERMILLE. Regression sanity: Δ ≥ 0 required.

commitDecision.description: commit_node gate decision. committed-to-registry → registry entry created. abort variants → discard checkpoint dir + escalate to next ADR.

registryEntry.description: If commitDecision = committed-to-registry: AT URI of moemoekyun-models.jsonl entry, e.g., at://did:web:mac-260317.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.modelRegistry.moemoekyun/3kt7g6...

councilRatificationRequired.description: True if this checkpoint is candidate for R3+ public release (baien-server-moemoekyun-v{N}); triggers Council Lv6+ ratification ticket per ADR-2605261900 §7.

councilRatificationTicketUri.description: If councilRatificationRequired: AT URI of Council ratification ticket.

postMortemNotes.description: Free-text notes if actualWall or actualCost deviated >50% from expected, or engineering failure occurred. Required for delta-insufficient / regression / engineering-failure / budget-overrun commitDecisions.

attestingDid.description: DID of attestor (typically same as rentalAttestation.attestingDid; mismatch triggers Council review).
